The Client and Server\nMUST store the Session after the Client and Server are disconnected.\n\n[MQTT-3.1.2-5]\n\nAfter the disconnection of a Session that had CleanSession set to 0, the\nServer MUST store further QoS 1 and QoS 2 messages that match any\nsubscriptions that the client had at the time of disconnection as part\nof the Session state.\n\n[MQTT-3.1.2-6]\n\nIf CleanSession is set to 1, the Client and Server MUST discard any\nprevious Session and start a new one. This Session lasts as long as the\nNetwork Connection. State data associated with this Session MUST NOT be\nreused in any subsequent Session.\n\n[MQTT-3.1.2.7]\n\nRetained messages do not form part of the Session state in the Server,\nthey MUST NOT be deleted when the Session ends.\n\n[MQTT-3.1.2-8]\n\nIf the Will Flag is set to 1 this indicates that, if the Connect request\nis accepted, a Will Message MUST be stored on the Server and associated\nwith the Network Connection.
